bundle.shortDescription: Desktop workspace for Codex and Claude CLI coding agents
bundle.longDescription: gtum is a cross-platform desktop workspace for running Codex and Claude CLI coding agents against local projects. It provides isolated terminal sessions, per-account agent profiles, and an approval gate that routes suggested commands into observable, isolated agent jobs.
